mechanism_narrative: A decline in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) from the previous month's level compresses the risk-free rate, reducing the discount rate for equity valuations and generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of months where FEDFUNDS declines from the prior month, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained unemployment rate (UNRATE) above 6.5% signals deteriorating labor market conditions that reduce consumer spending and corporate earnings, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of months where UNRATE >= 6.5, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in industrial production (INDPRO) and employment (PAYEMS) signals a severe economic contraction that triggers a flight to safety and negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of months where both INDPRO and PAYEMS decline from the prior month, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In the post-2008 financial crisis regime, a simultaneous rise in unemployment (UNRATE) above 6.5% and decline in industrial production (INDPRO) below 95.0 (index) signals a severe economic downturn that triggers negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of months meeting the regime and joint condition (UNRATE>=6.5 and INDPRO<95), or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in retail sales (RSAFS) from the previous month's level signals weak consumer demand, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of months where RSAFS declines from the prior month, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production (INDPRO) below 95.0 (index) signals a contraction in manufacturing and services, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of months where INDPRO < 95.0, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in housing starts (HOUST) below 800.0 and retail sales (RSAFS) below 350,000.0 (in millions) signals a collapse in consumer spending and housing market, generating negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of months where both HOUST < 800.0 and RSAFS < 350000.0, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in the core inflation rate (CPIAUCSL) from the previous month's level signals deflationary pressures that reduce corporate profit margins and generate negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of months where CPIAUCSL declines from the prior month, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.
